## Impact and limits

Affected: only npm post-write observation budget, its regression and operator guidance; new change records hold review/evidence. Unaffected by inspected diff: public CLI/package content, canonical skill/resource bytes, dependencies, schemas, generated metadata, authentication/approval/provider commands, GitHub/tag limits and published1.0.0 history. Existing generated checks execute through the real candidate path; no current published metadata is edited or claimed regenerated for publication. Release REL-SR-12/14/15/23 remain protected by exact identity, single-write and retained recovery behavior.

No broader validation redesign or historical-source retirement is included. Remote visibility can exceed this bound; exhaustion still reports incomplete and preserves recovery state. The recorded20minutes is approximate and excludes request latency. Hosted CI is unobserved before push and must be reported separately. Revert the bounded fix if needed; no package publication, release retry or customer installation is authorized by this Verify result. Next handoff is PR under the user's continuation request.
